# Copilot Instructions

## Directives de projet
- The user's original goal for the mapguide-maestro project is NOT just a .NET version upgrade, but a complete ground-up rebuild: migrate from Windows Forms to Avalonia UI for true cross-platform support, built on modern .NET 10 patterns and practices. This is based on the project roadmap comment about MapGuide Maestro 6.0 being the final WinForms release.
- MapGuide server URL for testing: [http://localhost:8058/mapguide/mapagent/mapagent.fcgi](http://localhost:8058/mapguide/mapagent/mapagent.fcgi)
